desc: This model is optics-ready out of the box, allowing direct mounting of red dot sights to the precision-machined slide cut. Night sights—featuring a front night sight and blacked-out rear—provide immediate target acquisition in low-light environments, while the trigger safety enhances drop protection without compromising responsiveness. The 1-in-9.8" twist barrel ensures stability with a wide range of 9mm loads, optimizing performance and reliability.
